```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (18, 10, 24),        # bottom mirror devices gm/Id
    "L_b":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),     # bottom L (ro + matching)
    "gmid_c": (20, 10, 24),        # cascode gm/Id (low Vdsat)
    "L_c":    (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),     # cascode L
    "vds_b":  (0.13, 0.08, 0.22),  # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin   = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout  = spec.get("iout_target", 5e-6)
    vnom  = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    ratio = iin / iout
    mi    = int(round(ratio))          # 4 unit fingers on the reference side
    iu    = iout                       # unit current = output current

    # bottom unit device (same in both branches, same Vds -> accurate ratio)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iu, vds=p["vds_b"], vsb=0.0)
    # cascode unit device, source sits at vds_b (body effect)
    mc_ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iu, vds=0.25, vsb=p["vds_b"])
    mc_out = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iu, vds=vnom - p["vds_b"], vsb=p["vds_b"])
    mc = mc_ref   # same W used in both branches (same L, gm/Id, Id)

    # bias resistor: V(iin) = Vgs_b + Iin*R must equal vds_b + Vgs_c
    R = max((p["vds_b"] + mc.vgs - mb.vgs) / iin, 1.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # reference branch: iin -> R -> a (gate of bottoms, drain of ref cascode)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "a", R)
    n.dev("M3", "a", "iin", "x", "vss", mc, m=mi)      # ref cascode, gate = iin
    n.dev("M1", "x", "a", "vss", "vss", mb, m=mi)      # ref bottom
    # output branch
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "y", "vss", mc, m=1)    # output cascode
    n.dev("M2", "y", "a", "vss", "vss", mb, m=1)       # output bottom

    # predictions
    gm4, gds4, gmbs4 = mc_out.gm, mc_out.gds, mc_out.gmbs
    gds2 = mb.gds
    rout = (1.0 / gds2) * (1.0 + (gm4 + gmbs4) / gds4)
    v_comp = p["vds_b"] + mc_out.vdsat * 0.9
    # residual error: small Vds difference at the cascode drains
    err = 100.0 * abs(gds4 * (vnom - 0.25 - p["vds_b"])) / max(gm4 + gmbs4, 1e-12) * 0.5
    power = (iin + iout) * 1.8
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": v_comp, "power": power}
```
